data.name: Google Calendar: List Events
data.description: List events from Google Calendar, optionally filtered by date range and max results.
data.instructions:
List events from Google Calendar within a date range.

Retrieve upcoming events, optionally filtered by date range and limited in count.

**Inputs:**
- {start_date}: Lower bound in RFC3339 format (optional)
- {end_date}: Upper bound in RFC3339 format (optional)
- {max_results}: Maximum number of events to return (optional)

**Output:** {result} contains the list of calendar events.
